http_port.label: HTTP Server Port
http_port.description: Port for the Web Kiosk HTTP server.

player_idle_timeout.label: Player Idle Timeout (minutes)
player_idle_timeout.description: Unregister kiosk players after this many minutes without activity.

show_stop_notification.label: Show notification before closing player
show_stop_notification.description: Show confirmation dialog in the kiosk when stopping playback from MA.

enable_sendspin_bridge.label: Sendspin bridge (experimental)
enable_sendspin_bridge.description: Register each kiosk under its browser Sendspin identity so it can join sample-synchronized playback groups on Music Assistant 2.11. When a synchronized stream starts, the kiosk opens in Sendspin mode. Playback falls back to the regular HTTP player when the kiosk cannot connect.

kiosk_url.label: Kiosk URL
kiosk_url.description: Open this URL in the kiosk browser. Append &token=<auth token> to enable MA API access.

manifest.description: Turn any browser into a fullscreen kiosk player
